title: Donut Summary Metric Value & Label Calibrated Responsive Sizing

complexity.rationale: S/M/L target font sizes were confirmed exact (not approximated) via the donut-chart-tokens skill. Two real design decisions were resolved during implementation rather than being purely mechanical: (1) diameters between named tiers snap to the nearest tier via midpoint cutpoints, not the old threshold scale's snap-down behavior, since truncation now protects against overflow regardless of which tier is picked; (2) the text truncation/fit-based visibility gate deliberately keeps using the real holeRatio-derived inner radius rather than the tier's fixed ring-width token, because getArcMark's actual rendered ring geometry is untouched by this spec and still holeRatio-based - using the tier's assumed ring width there would compute truncation against a hole that isn't actually rendered. That ring-geometry mismatch itself is filed separately as donut-ring-width-holeratio-mismatch.

summary: The Donut Summary (metric value + metric label centered in the donut) previously sized its text using a placeholder ratio (donutRadius * holeRatio * a fixed ratio constant) snapped through a single threshold scale, with the label always forced to exactly half the value's font size. The donut-chart-tokens skill documents the actual S2 design system: five named size tiers (XS/S/M/L/XL, fixed outer diameters) each with an independently-specified metric-value and metric-label font size. Implemented as two independent threshold scales (value, label) keyed off the donut's outer diameter, snapping to the nearest named tier via midpoint cutpoints. Text truncation/fit-based visibility intentionally continues to use the real holeRatio-derived inner radius (not the tier's ring-width token), since the actual ring geometry is a separate, currently-mismatched concern (see donut-ring-width-holeratio-mismatch). Confirmed with the user: which lines are shown (value, label, and the separately-tracked delta line in donut-summary-delta-line) is controlled by which optional props are supplied, not by the donut's size tier - every size tier can show any combination of lines.
requirements: Metric value ('metric total') font size must follow the exact per-size-tier px values confirmed in Figma's component-set variants: S (120px diameter) = 20px, M (160px) = 22px, L (200px) = 36px - all fontWeight 800, color gray-800/text-primary.

Metric label font size must follow the exact per-size-tier px values confirmed in Figma: S (120px) = 14px, M (160px) = 16px, L (200px) = 20px - all fontWeight 700, color gray-800/text-primary. Label font size is now looked up independently per tier, not derived as half the value's font size.

XS (60px diameter) and XL (400px diameter) use the donut-chart-tokens skill's derived values (metric total 18px/50px, metric label 12px/24px) as a starting point; these remain flagged as computed-not-measured and should be confirmed in Figma before being treated as final. Note: at the default holeRatio, XS's own font size is never actually observable, since its inner radius can never clear DONUT_SUMMARY_MIN_RADIUS (see donut-ring-width-holeratio-mismatch).

Font size must be keyed directly to the donut's outer diameter (2 * DONUT_RADIUS) against the five named size tiers, snapping to whichever tier's diameter is numerically closest (via midpoint cutpoints), not derived through the old holeRatio-based ratio formula.

Which lines render (value, label) is controlled by the props supplied (e.g. hideValue, whether a label is passed) at every size tier - not gated by the donut's size. The existing MIN_RADIUS-based fit fallback is unchanged (still keyed off the real holeRatio-derived inner radius) - it continues to hide text that's too small to render legibly, independent of the tier-based font-size lookup.

Long metric label text must continue to truncate (ellipsis) within the donut's inner hole radius at every size tier. The truncation limit continues to be computed from the real holeRatio-derived inner radius (unchanged basis) - not the tier's fixed ring-width token - since the actual rendered ring is still holeRatio-based (see donut-ring-width-holeratio-mismatch for the separate gap that creates).

designTokens.usage: Outer donut diameter per named size tier. Only S/M/L are true Figma component-set variants ('Donut (S)/(M)/(L)'); XS/XL are scaled instances, not their own variant sets.
Font size for the metric value text centered in the donut hole, keyed directly to the size tier's outer diameter.
Font size for the metric label text centered in the donut hole, keyed directly to the size tier's outer diameter, independent of the value's font size.

edgeCases.case: XS size tier (60px diameter) with a label supplied
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The label is hidden at the default holeRatio because its inner radius can never clear DONUT_SUMMARY_MIN_RADIUS at that diameter - not a hard suppression by design, but an inherent consequence of the current (mismatched) ring geometry. See donut-ring-width-holeratio-mismatch.

edgeCases.case: Donut diameter between named tiers (e.g. ~150px, between S=120 and M=160)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Resolved: snaps to the nearest tier via a midpoint cutpoint (140 between S and M), so 150px gets M's font sizes, not S's.
Resolved: the XL threshold-scale bucket has no upper bound, so any diameter >= the S/M midpoint... i.e. >= the L/XL cutpoint (300) uses XL's fixed font sizes - it does not continue scaling past XL.
Truncates with an ellipsis inside the real (holeRatio-derived) inner radius at every size tier, not overflowing the hole or overlapping the arc.

Label sizing follows its own independent per-tier font size regardless of hideValue; the limit formula's height-from-center calculation switches to half the label's own font size (no value/dy offset to account for) when hideValue is true.
The boolean/percent summary value uses the same corrected per-tier sizing as the standard aggregated sum value.

edgeCases.case: User-supplied custom holeRatio (not matching any named size tier)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Font size is unaffected by holeRatio (purely diameter-tier-based). Truncation/fit-based visibility remain holeRatio-derived as before, so a custom holeRatio changes how much text fits, exactly as it did pre-fix - no new interaction introduced by this spec.

s1's vega-spec-builder donutSummaryUtils.ts shares the identical placeholder formula/constants, but per project direction this work is s2-only - s1 is intentionally left unchanged, not a gap to track here.

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale: the single '_summaryFontSizeScale'/'_summaryFontSize' scale+signal (packages/vega-spec-builder-s2/src/donut/donutSummaryUtils.ts) were replaced with two independent pairs - '_summaryValueFontSizeScale'/'_summaryValueFontSize' and '_summaryLabelFontSizeScale'/'_summaryLabelFontSize' - each keyed off outer diameter against the five named tiers via shared midpoint cutpoints. requiresS1S2Parity is false: per project direction, this work is scoped to s2 only - packages/vega-spec-builder (s1) shares the identical placeholder formula today, but is intentionally left unchanged, not treated as a parity gap. Confirmed per the donut-chart-tokens skill (§5 Behavior tokens): hover/emphasize color changes apply to direct-label/advanced-label/benchmark-two-line values, not the plain center Metric total/label this spec covers - so touchesHoverAnimation and touchesLegendInteraction are correctly false here.

implementationPlan.change: Added (not replaced, since DONUT_SUMMARY_FONT_SIZE_RATIO/DONUT_SUMMARY_MIN_RADIUS are shared with s1 and must stay untouched) DONUT_SUMMARY_SIZE_TIER_CUTPOINTS (midpoint cutpoints [90,140,180,300]), DONUT_SUMMARY_VALUE_FONT_SIZES ([18,20,22,36,50]), and DONUT_SUMMARY_LABEL_FONT_SIZES ([12,14,16,20,24]).

getDonutSummaryScales/getDonutSummarySignals now produce two independent scale+signal pairs (value, label) keyed off 2 * DONUT_RADIUS against the shared tier cutpoints, replacing the single ratio-based scale/signal. getSummaryValueEncode/getSummaryValueLimit reference the new '_summaryValueFontSize' signal (formula basis unchanged - still holeRatio-derived for the limit). getSummaryLabelEncode now uses '_summaryLabelFontSize' directly (no longer ceil(value*0.5)) and recomputes its limit's height-from-center as labelFontSize*0.5 (hideValue) or dy-offset+labelFontSize (otherwise) - an exact algebraic generalization of the old multiplier-based formula once label size is independent.

Updated scale/signal-name assertions for the two-scale/two-signal split; added assertions pinning the value/label font-size arrays and cutpoints directly, plus new getSummaryLabelEncode tests for the independent fontSize and the two limit-formula branches.
implementationPlan.lines: N/A - updated and new test cases

implementationPlan.change: Updated the integration render tests that hardcoded the old ratio-derived font sizes at specific widths - replaced the 'snap based on inner radius' describe block with tests pinning S/M/L/XL tiers by outer diameter (XS omitted - never observable through the MIN_RADIUS fit gate at default holeRatio) plus a nearest-tier-snapping case.

New story (in the non-pre-alpha Donut story location used for new s2 donut feature work going forward) rendering all five named size tiers side by side so the corrected per-tier sizing is visually verifiable in Storybook.

openQuestions: The two 'derived' (computed, not individually measured) values are still unconfirmed in Figma: XS metric-total 18px/metric-label 12px, and XL metric-total 50px/metric-label 24px. Used as documented in the interim.
